notes.title: A Sense of Achievement in a Cruel World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35805840/b13028914f8d51096d437c341a1f73484cd3b4db.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello, Fearfolks![/h2]

The sun is burning hot, and so is the fury of the mighty beast invaded in his own home by puny humans. But even a being that perfect and powerful needs motivation to keep going. Of course, survival is one, and for the player that means acquiring the highest score possible, but what if there was something more? Something that gave you a sense of accomplishment… [b]No, no, a sense of achievement![/b]

[h3]We’re happy to report, that we’ve updated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1091590/achievements]all the achievement graphics[/url] to give you even more reason to keep slaying the weaklings who think they can push you out of your lair.[/h3]

[b]Go on now, paint the walls with their blood, and listen to the sweet sounds of getting those achievements.[/b] Doesn’t get more satisfying than that.

[b]Until next time, beasts![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091590/Cathedral_3D/

[h2]Hello, fearfolks![/h2]

notes.title: Patch 2.0: The “Free to Play” Update!
notes.content:
Hello, Fearfolks and retro shooter enthusiasts!

As we have said, so has been done, the 2.0 update is here and Cathedral 3-D is going free to play! This patch took a lot of work and we’re very proud to present the changelog and get you up to date with all the new ways you can defend your Cathedral from these puny sacks of meat trying to chase you out of your domain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35805840/3469634320500a12c2f08790efa26b46780108df.png[/img]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h3][GAMEPLAY CHANGES][/h3]
We have redesigned the magic system, check out the new spells:
[list]
[*] Teleport the chest to your hands!
[*] Warp to the current location of the chest (super helpful when falling down!)
[*] Invincibility, so you can really become unstoppable.
[/list]

[h3][ARENA CHANGES][/h3]
[list]
[*] We redesigned the arena and added a large new area below. Go and explore!
[*] Enemies now can teleport around the arena, beware!
[*] We added new demonic altars that can protect the chest from enemy attacks. They also provide slow healing over time.
[/list]

[h3][IMPROVEMENTS][/h3]
[list]
[*] Due to numerous gameplay changes, we introduced a new leaderboard. The old one is still available in read-only mode.
[*] We have refreshed and improved the graphics of the arena.
[/list]

[h3][FIXES][/h3]
[list]
[*] We implemented numerous small fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

Alright, that’s it, go on, tear some humans apart and get that high score! Did we mention that Cathedral 3-D is free to play now? Well, it is!

Don’t forget to leave your feedback and thoughts in the comments below because we really appreciate hearing from you guys.

See you next time, here or on Chapel 3-D! ;)

notes.title: Patch 1.6.66 is out now!
notes.content:
[i]Giorgio from Feardemic here.

Patch 1.6.66 introduces a bunch of bug fixes and tweaks in preparation for the next content update. "What content update?", you might ask, and the answer is "You'll find out when it's ready". Just know that is a major overhaul that will include new game modes, maps, and much, much more.[/i]


[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[u][b][IMPROVEMENTS][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Optimised the saving process of replays after a run. This is the first of many upcoming changes that will address missing replays on the leaderboard.
[*] Minor setting UI redesign. Keyboard and controller binding is now displayed as a single list.
[/list]

[u][b][FIXES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that occasionally caused the game to crash and lose the saved configuration while closing the game
[*] Fixed a bug that made some users crash to desktop during gameplay when too many NPCs were on the map.
[*] Solved a performance issue caused by the second wave on GNU/Linux.
[*] Fixed multiple memory leaks that were causing the game to use an increasing amount of memory during longer gameplay sessions.
[*] Corrected the movement patterns of some NPCs (knights, archers) during attacks.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4 OUT NOW
notes.content:
[i]Hey Monsters, this is Giorgio from Feardemic.

The recent influx of new players pushed the developer to work harder on improving the game experience, hence why we are pleased to announce that a new update has just been released on Steam.

And yes, [b]that[/b] annoying lag issue has finally been solved! Keep the feedback coming - we are always listening.

By the way — we haven't forgot about support for Mac and Linux, and the promised additional content. Keep ready for patch 1.5 next month and be ready to expect new maps, game modes, and even more surprising stuff...

Lastly, one interesting fact: so far not a single player managed to defeat The Hand – the mysterious entity mentioned in the 'how to play' section. This also means nobody has found the way to beat the game yet (yes, you've read that right, there's an endgame condition), so we are considering some spicy contest idea to challenge everyone to do their best...

Keep following this hub to find out more!
[/i]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[u][b][IMPROVEMENTS][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Significant performance upgrades due to optimized physics engine and renderer.
[*] New prettier clouds.
[*] New glossy shader on stained glass and new blood splashes.
[*] Small UI upgrades (e.g. proper checkboxes in the settings menu).
[/list]

[u][b][FIXES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed an infamous issue that caused stuttering on certain hardware configurations.
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally made archers and wizards invisible.
[*]The chest will no longer move horizontally when the player jumps on top of it.
[*]Disabled a glitch that allowed the player to repeatedly drop chest, jump on top of it, then grab it and jump again. It was hilarious to watch, but it was time to fix it.
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally made the game launching as a background process on some versions of Windows.
[*]Fixed a glitch that occasionally made fire effects over burning enemies appearing as straight vertical lines.
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally made secondary light sources (e.g. pickups) disappearing during the gameplay.
[*]Fixed an issue with the blending of some visual effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - A Bloody Mess
notes.content:
Hey, Giorgio from Feardemic here.

Today we are introducing a brand new feature into Cathedral 3-D: [u][b]melee attacks[/b][/u].

There are basically two new ways to kill enemies:

[i]rip and tear[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35805840/23d4ba754a8d28f01e8ed073d6be7d16fa5d4480.gif[/img]

Press 'E' to use your claws and tear those puny humans apart!

[i]crush them[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35805840/685aa6fcbbf7f76c69b5306deb06a5f6ee1ebe66.gif[/img]

The chest has been weaponized and can now be thrown against the enemy to crush them!

Oh, and throwing enemies now works as originally intended - make them experience gravity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35805840/994f916c722900534f78bcef1a4fb9f493a8305c.gif[/img]

On top of that, as you might have noticed, enemies now leave a bloody mess around. Also, fire attacks now leave burn marks on the surfaces.

And now, here's the full changelog!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[u][b][NEW FEATURES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a melee attack
[*] Chest can now crush enemies
[*] Added gibbing
[*] Added blood and burn decals
[/list]

[u][b][IMPROVEMENTS][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Game version number is now displayed on replays
[*] Completely reworked rendering pipeline - performances are now sensibly smoother
[/list]
 
[b][u][GAMEPLAY BALANCE][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Throwing enemies now casts them REALLY afar
[*] Player now moves faster when holding the chest
[*] Chest now regenerates ammo based on landing jumps. Idle time-based ammo regeneration has been removed
[/list]

[u][b][FIXES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a design issue that made player impossible to kill in a certain spot of the map
[*] Fixed a funny bug that occasionally made grabbed enemies smaller
[*] Fixed an issue that made some players experience sudden mouse sensitivity changes
[/list]

[h1]What's coming next[/h1]

First and foremost, we'd like to address some concerns we've read over the forum and the reviews, as some of you have been expressed dissatisfaction for the lack of regular updates and lack of new contents. On the first point, you might have noticed that updates have no longer been published on a weekly basis. The reason behind that is pretty simple: reality hit us.

Cathedral 3-D launch hasn't been a success, and neither us nor the developer are currently making any money out of it, as we haven't even recovered the costs yet. While Cathedral 3-D is a game about impersonating a terrifying monster, we are still just humans and have to pay bills and bring food to our tables, therefore we have no other choice but to prioritize our daily jobs.

[h3]BUT![/h3]

Today's patch should be a pretty clear signal that we are still committed to Cathedral 3-D and its players, and since we cannot promise you patches on a regular basis, future updates will always have more juicy stuff than just a few fixes as the last one.

With that in mind, the following is a non-exhaustive list of things that are in the works and that will be added with future updates:
[list]
[b][*] New maps
[*] New game modes
[*] New enemies
[*] Full Mac and Linux support
[*] An external leaderboard
[*] More achievements
[*] Steam trading cards and other flairs
[*] Key bindings and other accessibility options 
[*] An endless list of technical improvements and fixes[/b]
[/list]

Enjoy your holidays monsters, see you very soon next year,
Giorgio


PS: today we have also released a cheesy new trailer that we hope will make undecided users who wishlisted the game more curious about it. You can check it out here:
[previewyoutube=0l2IywD8Lug;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 changelog
notes.content:
[i]Hey Monsters, this is Giorgio.

We have started to work on major content updates (such as maps and game modes have started), therefore fixes for this weekly patch are in a smaller number compared to the previous ones, but nevertheless, here we are with a new changelog - this time is based mostly on balancing. The patch will be live in approximately 2 hours.
[/i]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[u][b][BALANCING][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Killing doves now awards 4 points per dove killed
[*] Doves' attacks now deliver slightly increased damages to the player
[*] Monster's primary attack is now slightly faster but the projectiles are slightly affected by gravity
[*] Monster's shotgun-like attack now shoots a higher number of projectiles with a slightly bigger spread
[*] Monster's fireball attack power cost and buffer time have been slightly increased
[*] Max chest freeze time is now shorter (20 to 16 seconds)
[/list]

[u][b][FIXES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Further improvements to overall system stability and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user experience
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2 changelog
notes.content:
[i]Hey Monsters, Giorgio from Feardemic here.

First and foremost: [u][b]Feardemic now has a Discord server![/b][/u] Just press the Discord logo to join!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jTvYrg4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35805840/56f7cdc6e90bafeb2232475613ab5e4e878d5ea1.png[/img][/url]

On our Discord you'll be able to get in touch with the dev of Cathedral 3-D, as well as occasionally meet those of other Feardemic productions such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433550/DARQ/]DARQ[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/]One Shell Straight to Hell[/url]. And, of course, get first hand news and updates on all of our games.

Since we are just getting started with it, the server is quite basic and we don't have a dedicated community manager for it yet, but we want to keep expanding its scope and functionalities, and eventually reward the most active and long-standing users, so don't wait to jump in!

And now, here's the changelog for patch 1.2.[/i]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[u][b][IMPROVEMENTS][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Beating your previous record will now prompt a "New high score" text
[*] Players can now press 'ESC' at the launch to skip to the menu view before the animation completes
[*] Added an accessibility option to disable fixed mouse cursor
[*] Faster loading times and improved general game performances
[/list]

[u][b][BUG FIXES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Enemies no longer get stuck into things
[*] Projectiles are no longer glitching during replays
[*] Rocket jumping with fire bombs now works correctly
[*] Corpses on fire are now correctly displayed during replays
[*] Sky colours changes are now correctly displayed during replays
[*] Angels and their projectiles are now correctly displayed during replays
[*] Players are no longer occasionally respawning when falling out of the map
[*] Enemies are now correctly dealing damage at the end of the attack animations
[*] Fixed an issue that made possible unlocking certain achievements without meeting their conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 out now
notes.content:
[i]Hey everyone, this is Giorgio from Feardemic. 

On behalf of both Feardemic and Unfinished Games, thank you all for having supported the launch of Cathedral 3-D! 

While we cannot hide it's been quite a rocky one, we want you to know that we have great regard for all the feedback you provided us and that we intend to honour that by releasing regular, weekly updates to ensure that the game will work as intended on every PC.

But it doesn't end there: while Cathedral 3-D is a small game (as you can tell by the price), we intend to increase its scope by adding [b]new game modes, maps and gameplay features that will make it worth for you to come back to play it by time to time[/b] - keep following this community hub  for further updates!

And now, here's the changelog for patch 1.1.[/i]

[u][b][NEW FEATURES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added 27 new achievements (including 3 secret ones!)
[/list]

[u][b][IMPROVEMENTS][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added kill count, combos and score counts in replays
[*] Added option to invert mouse Y axis
[*] Added quick restart button - it's now possible to restart a run by simply pressing "R" at any time during the run
[*] You can now close the options menu by simply pressing ESC
[/list]
 
[b][u][GAMEPLAY BALANCE][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Wizards are now being spawned only from the 2nd wave onward
[/list]

[u][b][FIXES][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made some players unable to set records above 100,000 points
[*] Fixed a bug that made enemies T-posing during replays
[*] Fixed a bug that made enemies getting stuck on top of the towers
[*] Fixed a bug that occasionally made projectiles ignore collisions with walls
[*] Fixed a compatibility issue that made performances drop drastically on older hardware when too many enemies grouped together
[*] Adjusted player shooting height to prevent projectiles ignoring enemies at the closest range
[/list]
